In reference to captioned subject, we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company, in their Board Meeting
held today, i.e. on Saturday, November 14, 2026, at the Registered Office of the Company situated at Plot No. F - 55, Addl.
MIDC Area Ajanta Road, Jalgaon- 425003, Maharashtra, which was commenced at 12:30 P.M. and concluded at 2:30 P.M,
has inter-alia;
1. Considered and approved the Unaudited Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the half year
ended on September 30, 2026, along with Statement of Assets and Liabilities and Cash Flow Statement as per
provisions of Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, along with Limited Review Report;
2. Considered and approved all other business as per agenda circulated.
